recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular composition of three women wearing wide-brimmed fedoras, featuring high-contrast warm studio lighting and a grainy film texture. The subjects are layered with one in the foreground center and two flanking her in the mid-ground. The lower-left corner features bold, lowercase geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of faces creating a balanced focal point
Repetition of hat shapes providing rhythmic structure
Contrast between dark textured clothing and warm skin tones
Typography anchored to the bottom-left corner overlapping the subject
coreInvariants: Wide-brimmed fedora hats on all subjects
Heavy film grain and saturated shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a tight group shot; center figure is slightly lower and larger in the frame, creating a downward-pointing triangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face and the bright white typography in the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central face upward to the flanking faces, then down to the high-contrast text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is filled with the subjects' heads and shoulders against a neutral tan background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep burgundy and black (clothing and hats)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows; deep, crushed blacks in the shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a circular bowl and no spur
Lowercase 't' with a simple crossbar and no tail curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varied placement for visual interest.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 90s era aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and uniform weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three women in a triangular formation wearing burgundy fedoras and pinstripe/textured black clothing. Use warm amber lighting, deep shadows, and visible film grain. Background is a flat tan color.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner. Stack the words tightly so they overlap the subject's shoulder.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and high-contrast?
Is the text anchored to the bottom-left?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for triangular composition of faces
Ensure typography is solid white and lowercase
Verify presence of fedoras on all subjects
Confirm warm color cast and film grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Trio portrait + fedoras + warm studio lighting + geometric lowercase typography + bottom-left alignment.
